pirouette.config.title: Pirouette Settings
pirouette.tooltip.angle: How far to turn. 360 is one full circle.
pirouette.tooltip.duration: How long the turn takes. Shorter is faster.
pirouette.tooltip.curve: How the turn speeds up and slows down. Click to change; the preview shows the shape.
pirouette.tooltip.direction: Right turns clockwise, left turns counter-clockwise. Alternate flips every time.
pirouette.tooltip.enabled: Turns all Pirouette keys on or off.
pirouette.tooltip.repeat: What the key does if you press it again while a spin is running.
pirouette.tooltip.cancel_on_move: Stops the spin as soon as you move the mouse.
pirouette.tooltip.cooldown: Minimum wait after a spin before the next one can start.
pirouette.tooltip.test: Closes this screen and plays the current spin in your world.
pirouette.tooltip.reset: Puts this tab back to its default values.
